parameters.name: BackendServers
parameters.description:
The list of backend servers to add. You can add up to 20 backend servers per invoke.

> Backend servers (ENS instances) must be in the Running state before they can be added to a load balancing instance.

sub_parameters.name: Ip
sub_parameters.description: The IP address of the backend server.

sub_parameters.name: Port
sub_parameters.description: The backend port used by the load balancing instance.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The backend server type. Valid values:
- **ens**: ENS instance.
- **eni**: network interface controller (NIC) instance.

sub_parameters.name: Weight
sub_parameters.description:
The weight of the backend server. Default value: 100. Valid values: **0** to **100**.

> A value of 0 indicates that no requests are forwarded to the backend server.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerId
parameters.description: The frontend port used by the load balancing instance. Valid values: **1** to **65535**.
